title: Lighter, cleaner Zuno
items: Zuno is lighter: it does almost nothing while you're idle, and typing and scrolling through chats are much smoother.
Messages are cleaner: the flat Classic style is now the default. You can switch back to Bubbles in Settings › Appearance.
While something loads you see a sketch of it (messages, lists, cards, the sign-in page) instead of plain grey bars.
Games you play now show their real picture on your profile instead of a blank window icon.
You can delete your account in Settings › My Account (at the bottom).
Fixed: changing your banner color now saves.
Senior and Talented Artists can send up to 6 creations for review at once.
Verified Creators can pick a Red or Dark badge look in Settings › My Account.
Channel permissions have a search box.
In Zuno Official, only staff can ping @everyone.
Staff: Moderation is simpler, with new Bans & Timeouts and Servers tabs, Unban, and ending server bans and timeouts from one place.
